summary: User asked how operator messages are received by headless agents. Identified critical communication gap: blocked agent has yielded and cannot receive clarifications if its only wakeup is challenge satisfaction. Revised P1 operator challenge conversation task task-8b79dd419d94405793a17aa18c1d0b28 spec from version 1 to version 2 with explicit delivery architecture. For Working agent, every Jarvis tool response includes small pending operator message flag/IDs, agent fetches bounded summaries via agent_inbox and transcript via get_challenge, private contents not injected into generic responses. For Ready/Blocked/taskless agent, headless runner needs separate message-only continuation on unread operator reply, deduplicated and authenticated, allowing two-way clarification without changing blocked task/claiming Ready. Explicit ALL challenge satisfaction alone wakes substantive blocked task to Ready. No active model can be interrupted between tool calls; no runner leaves message persistently unread and TUI must distinguish queued/delivered/read.
